ideas.pitch: An offline-first voice biomarker and triage assistant for rural ASHA workers running on low-cost Android devices.
ideas.title: AshaConnect
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the rural empowerment and healthcare themes by solving a real workflow bottleneck for frontline health workers.

ideas.pitch: A peer-to-peer mesh network content-sharing app enabling rural schools to cache educational video content via local Wi-Fi hotspots without active internet.
ideas.title: GramVani AudioHub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the severe connectivity limitation in rural education with an innovative, working prototype using local hardware protocols.

ideas.pitch: A vernacular voice-activated diagnostic tool for crop diseases that reads local agricultural advisories aloud in regional dialects.
ideas.title: KrishiBhasha AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines cutting-edge local ML inference with immediate economic utility for farmers, hitting the core Tech for Humanity mandate.

ideas.pitch: An IoT-based low-cost water contamination and turbidity monitor using ESP32 that sends SMS alerts to village panchayats.
ideas.title: JalSuraksha IoT
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates full-stack hardware and software integration which always stands out in technical university hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An offline-capable adaptive quiz generator for school children in rural areas that dynamically adjusts difficulty based on local curriculum patterns.
ideas.title: SikshaSetu
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a quantifiable learning improvement metric that judges can easily test during judging rounds.
